1.title: 概覽
content: 作為努巴尼（Numbani）的守護者而生，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）比任何人都更能守住前線。她可以說是坦克中最難被擊殺的角色，且在擁有高生存能力的同時，還具備相當不錯的傷害輸出。雖然她的機動性遠遠落後，但她的遠程傷害能力在所有坦克中名列前茅。優秀的歐瑞莎玩家懂得如何循環使用冷卻技能，並在等待![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦（Fortify）冷卻完畢時善用掩體。如果你想在目標點上持續進行攻擊，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎會是一個很好的選擇。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 旋轉並保持距離。![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎應該始終與隊伍一同圍繞目標移動，試圖將敵方隊伍阻擋在外。

* 不要將她的技能一次全部用完。先使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉，待其結束後再使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦，接著使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍。將這些技能同時使用會大幅降低她的生存能力。

* 務必在掩體附近遊玩。由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦的使用間隔總會出現空窗期，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎需要掩體來躲避傷害以維持生存。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 忽略 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎。對付 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最好的方式就是避開她，並鎖定她隊伍中的其他人。她會試圖阻止你，但她無法追上你。

* 等待 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）效果結束。如果你看到她變為金色，要麼躲起來以免受到傷害，要麼切換目標去攻擊其他人。

* 使用光束武器。如果其他方法都無效，對付 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最簡單的方式就是使用具備光束武器的英雄。對於這些英雄來說，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎簡直是免費的絕招能量來源。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 堅毅（Fortify）
* 適合用來進行反制選角（counter-pick）
* 遠程傷害
* 容易受到光束武器（beams）的威脅
* 無法減免隊友受到的傷害
* 移動緩慢且缺乏機動性

3.1.1.title: 堅毅（Fortify）
content: 變得無法阻擋並減少近乎一半的受傷量是 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最強大的優勢。她是唯一一位能夠在向前推進並進行攻擊的同時，保持對控場效果免疫的坦克。

3.1.2.title: 絕佳的換角選擇
content: 符合劇情設定，她能透過自身的控場能力反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王，並利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦（Fortify）的擊退免疫效果來應對。![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎同時也是絕佳的換角選擇，能有效壓制 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特、![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔、![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害。

3.1.3.title: 遠程傷害
content: 大多數坦克英雄的遠程傷害能力極低，甚至完全沒有。在戰鬥的消耗階段，或是處於中長距離時，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎能為隊伍帶來的價值將高於任何其他坦克。

3.2.1.title: 容易受到光束攻擊
content: 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）無法像 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅和 ![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)辛梅塔那樣格擋光束傷害，因此只要 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）處於冷卻狀態，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎就會變得非常容易受到光束攻擊。

3.2.2.title: 無團隊傷害減免
content: 與大多數其他戰士（Bruiser）不同，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）無法為隊伍提供任何額外生命值或護盾。她只能用自己的身體或透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）來吸收攻擊，但無法直接為隊友帶來任何額外的生存能力。

3.2.3.title: 行動遲緩
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）最大的弱點在於開火時會被緩速，且缺乏垂直機動性，僅能透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）獲得極少量的移動速度加成。機動性高的英雄可以輕易避開 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa），而她對此也無能為力。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：強化融合驅動器（Augmented Fusion Driver）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/945c6006c1ad69b0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faugmented-fusion-driver.png)強化融合驅動器（Augmented Fusion Driver）的使用技巧**
* 保持距離並進行騷擾

* ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）擁有比其他任何戰士（Bruiser）更優異的遠程傷害能力。![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga）或許能與之一較高下，但透過![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦（Fortify），他的燃燒槍枝甚至無法對![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）造成暴擊。在敵方戰士（Bruiser）靠近你之前，盡可能輸出最多的傷害。
* 不要過熱
* 在即將過熱前停止射擊，總比受到 3 秒的過熱懲罰要好。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：能量標槍（Energy Javelin）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍（Energy Javelin）技巧
* 保持距離

* 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）的射程通常優於其他戰士（Bruiser），她應該利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）將敵人推開，與自己保持距離。
* 保護後排

* ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍（Energy Javelin）的擊退效果是將敵人阻擋在後排之外的強力工具。如果你發現敵方的戰士（Bruiser）或輸出位正在攻擊你身後的隊友，試著用 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍（Energy Javelin）擊中他們。
* 牆面碰撞

* 當 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍（Energy Javelin）將敵人擊退並撞上牆壁時，會造成額外的暈眩與傷害。試著透過繞著目標移動，讓他們處於你與牆壁或建築物之間，藉此發揮此技能的最大效益。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：堅毅（Fortify）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）使用技巧

* ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）最重要的技能

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）幾乎無法被擊殺，且在字面上完全無法被阻擋。當使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）時，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）可以向前推進、反制控場技能（CC），並迫使敵方隊伍撤退。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）的冷卻時間很長，因此務必不要浪費。只有在敵方隊伍必須集火你，且你透過傷害輸出與站位構成實質威脅時，才啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）。
* 在你仍擁有護甲時使用

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)在你仍擁有護甲時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify），可以疊加傷害減免效果（最高可達 50%）。此外，如果你在啟動技能時還有護甲，那麼當 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）結束時，你更有可能還保留著部分護甲值。

* 如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）結束且你沒有護甲了，快跑！
* 反制絕招

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)當敵人擁有如 ![](/data/assets/guide/7578824db04164d2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblizzard.png)暴雪（Blizzard）、![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）、![](/data/assets/guide/c95892af1b952964.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgravitic-flux.png)重力流（Gravitic Flux）、![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）等類似的暈眩型絕招時，請保留 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）。

4.4.title: [E]：標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）的技巧
* 與堅韌防禦（Fortify）交替使用

* * 請勿在施放![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦（Fortify）的同時使用![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）。你需要將這兩項生存工具分開使用，否則敵人將會有很長一段空窗期可以擊殺![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎。
* 確保擊殺

* * 由於![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）可以阻擋敵方的治療與傷害投射物，同時還能對敵人造成控場效果（CC），因此在收割低生命值目標時非常有效。

* 移動到目標與其支援英雄之間，然後啟動![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）將他們推向你的隊伍。
* 標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）無法阻擋什麼？

* * 無法阻擋光束類攻擊或濺射傷害，也無法在![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)辛梅塔的哨戒塔落地前將其摧毀。

4.5.title: 絕招：大地崩擊（Terra Surge）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)大地崩擊（Terra Surge）的使用技巧**

* 我該蓄力![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)大地崩擊（Terra Surge）多久？

* * 你需要引導![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）的絕招約 3 秒，才能一擊擊殺傷害型與支援型英雄。
* 無視屏障

* * 猛擊傷害無法被像![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）護盾這類屏障所阻擋。
* 斷開視線（LoS）可停止傷害

* * 視線（LoS）可用來避免受到傷害。因此，任何環境結構或![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美（Mei）與![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）的牆體都可以阻擋傷害。
* 取得高度優勢

* * If ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is above the enemy (![](/data/assets/guide/d747d16d3747ce4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpetal-platform.png)Petal Platform, jumping, jumping off high ground, etc.) the enemies will first be pulled all the way up to ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa, then have to fall way back down to the ground before being able to walk away.
* 啟動前務必跳躍，但只要可能，請利用運載目標或環境來獲得額外高度。

5.1.1.title: 防禦協定（Defense Protocol）
5.1.1.description: 在引導大地崩裂（Terra Surge）期間，每秒恢復 100 點生命值。
content: * 讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)大地崩裂（Terra Surge）成為一個還算不錯的緊急保命技能。治療效果能讓你承受更多傷害，並在生命值偏低時救你一命。

5.1.2.title: 機動防禦
5.1.2.description: 當「堅毅防禦（Fortify）」啟動時，歐瑞莎不會受到移動速度減益，也不會產生熱能。
content: * 非常強大，且能在 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎處於巔峰狀態時，進一步強化其侵略性打法。對敵方隊伍來說，這會讓她顯得勢不可擋。

5.2.1.title: 蓄力標槍（Charged Javelin）
5.2.1.description: 能量標槍（Energy Javelin）可以進行蓄力，以提升投射物速度與擊退效果。在完全蓄力時可穿透敵人。
content: * 整體而言，這是較佳的主要特殊能力（major perks）。

* * In most scenarios, having to give up ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin is not worth the barrier. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is already very tanky, and ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin blocks all projectiles for almost 2 seconds. Moreover, the speed boost during and after, plus the CC is stronger than having a shield.

5.2.2.title: 防護屏障（Protective Barrier）
5.2.2.description: 標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）將被替換為屏障。
content: * 視對戰組合而定

* 針對 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加（Mauga），這可能被視為較佳的「主要特殊能力（major perks）」，因為它可以用來反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）。

* 針對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅（Zarya），當她使用防護泡泡時部署屏障，以阻擋她的傷害，並減輕必須擊破她的屏障且為其充能的壓力。

* 理論上，你可以使用屏障來阻擋 ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）絕招的視線（LoS），並嘗試提前結束該絕招。然而，這 600 生命值的屏障可能無法存活夠久，不建議過度依賴此技巧。
* 雙重屏障技巧
* 當處於防守方或敵方隊伍正從重生點返回時，將屏障垂直向上發射。等到它落地時，距離你下一個屏障的冷卻時間僅剩 3 秒。

6.title: 地圖
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)在偏好消耗陣容的地圖上，歐瑞莎（Orisa）總是不錯的選擇。擁有開闊空間與長直護送路線的目標區域能發揮她的優勢。由於她非常耐打，在小型地圖上表現也不差，但這會讓她難以執行拉開距離的戰術計畫。她可以利用遠程傷害來爭奪高地，但她自己無法登上高地，因此在那些有利於機動陣容、且擁有大量高地的地圖上，她會處於劣勢。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 將 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎與其他 Poke（遠程消耗）英雄搭配，在敵方隊伍靠近你們之前就將其擊潰。她也是一名出色的保護者，因此當敵方隊伍使用 Dive（機動突擊）或 Rush（強攻）陣容時，她能成為對手的夢魘，阻擋所有 CC（控場技能）、將敵人擊退，並確保隊友能安全地進行輸出。

由於她的機動性較低，像 ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)巴帝斯特和 ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)伊拉里這類支援型英雄能很輕易地將她的生命值維持在健康狀態。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 若要反制歐瑞莎（Orisa），你需要利用她冷卻時間的空檔。如果她還有 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）可以使用，她幾乎是殺不死的。如果你看到她用掉了這兩個技能，她會有短暫的脆弱期。在堅毅（Fortify）冷卻時間結束前，請迅速採取進攻。

為了達成這個目標，你必須確保在對方使用技能後，自己手中仍有剩餘的資源。因此，當你看到她啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）時，請專注於防守、後撤並保留你的冷卻技能。如此一來，你就能擁有足夠的手段來懲罰她並贏得會戰。
